evals.prompt: Review evals/files/simulation-results.html as a scientific software UX review. Do not edit it. Give findings with consequence, fix, and how to verify.
evals.expected_output: Findings on missing units, ambiguous run identity, hidden parameters and version, rerun overwriting provenance, zero vs missing/failed, 'Done' conflating completion with validity, and unscoped delete.
expectations: Flags temperature, pressure, and yield shown without units
Flags two runs both named 'Baseline' with no stable run ID or version
Flags that 'default settings' hides the actual resolved parameters and model version
Flags that Re-run replaces results in place instead of creating a linked new run
Questions whether yield 0 means zero, missing, failed, or below detection
Distinguishes the 'Done' status from scientific validity or QC acceptance
Flags that Delete acts on every filtered row without showing scope or allowing recovery
Stays read-only and does not invent scientific values or valid ranges
